title: Degree-shifted derived invariance of derived delooping levels
summary: Gélinas introduced the delooping level of an Artin algebra as a homological invariant that bounds the big finitistic dimension of the opposite algebra. A natural question is whether such invariants are preserved under derived equivalences. Chen recently showed that the finiteness of the classical delooping level and its sub-derived variant is not derived-invariant, but the case of the finer derived delooping level of Guo and Igusa remained open.
